quote.notes: Bid proposal 'CLS - CLAY DEERING BUDGET', Austin TX, bid date 11/25/2026, rep Cooper Scott. Quantities are the Innovation Building #2 Phases 2 and 3 takeoff. Prices valid 30 days from the quote if released for manufacture; subject to tariff, fuel and raw-material increases. Tax 0.00 on the quote ('actual taxes may vary'). The 8 rolls of 12x1000 ft green sewer detection tape show $999,999.00 each on the quote ($7,999,992, nearly all of the $8,686,078.12 total), a placeholder; carried at $10.00 per roll per Clay Deering (11/17/2026). Fire hydrant assemblies: 14 at $5,500 each per Clay Deering (11/17/2026), not on the printed quote; 8 in Phase 2 and 6 in Phase 3 (per Clay Deering). Quote total with these: $763,166.12. Section totals: sewer pipe $64,857.86, water $363,998.68, storm pipe $137,162.95, storm structures $53,774.91, wastewater manholes $55,597.40, cleanouts $10,694.32. Not quoted: the 33 FUTURE storm structures.
